# DocsBot AI

> > DocsBot AI is an AI-powered chatbot platform that uses GPT-4o, RAG, and NLP to automate customer support, knowledge management, and lead generation.

DocsBot AI enables businesses to train custom AI chatbots on their documentation and knowledge bases, integrating with platforms like Zendesk, Zapier, and OttoKit. The platform features advanced capabilities including Agentic RAG with multi-query, GPT-5 support, and seamless integrations for support automation and customer retention.

## Key Topics

- DocsBot AI
- GPT-4o and GPT-5
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Customer Support Automation
- AI Chatbots and Conversational AI
- Knowledge Management
- Zendesk Integration
- ChatGPT API
- Lead Generation
- Customer Retention and Churn Reduction
- Ticketing Systems
- Zapier and Workflow Automation
- SaaS Support Solutions
- OpenAI Models
